text: {"lessons":["My account has declined gradually, so I should prioritize preserving savings and avoid taking risks I cannot afford in retirement.","Selling Stock E at a loss did not prevent the account from falling afterward; I should base future trades on the outlook and my risk limits, not on the loss alone.","With only a few periods of experience and no need to trade often, I should review my holdings calmly and make deliberate changes rather than react to small monthly moves."]}
